About the studio

Built by developers,
not a marketing team.

ForgeGen Technologies is a Salem, Tamil Nadu–based web development studio started by student founders who wanted to build websites the way an engineer would — with real code, real performance, and real ownership handed to the client. No page builders, no recycled templates.

We work directly with small and medium businesses — the kind that need a site that actually converts visitors into customers, not just one that looks nice in a screenshot.

Questions

Frequently asked.

How long does a typical project take?

+

A landing page usually takes 3–7 days. A full business site runs 2–4 weeks depending on scope. E-commerce and custom apps are quoted individually after a scoping call.

How many revisions are included?

+

Every tier includes revision rounds during the build phase, agreed on upfront so there's no ambiguity about what's included.

Do you help with hosting and domain setup?

+

Yes — we can guide you through domain registration and deployment, or handle it for you as part of the project.

How does payment work?

+

Projects typically start with an upfront deposit, with the balance due at launch. Exact terms are confirmed in your quote.

What happens after launch?

+

Every project includes a defined post-launch support window for fixes and small adjustments. Ongoing maintenance can be arranged separately.
